found: In January 2023, J&J guided 2023 adjusted operational EPS of $10.50, reflecting growth of 3.5% [1].

The July 2023 release says the company is increasing its full-year guidance midpoints for adjusted operational EPS [2]. The guidance table shows adjusted operational EPS midpoints of $10.65 (5.0% growth) and $10.55 (4.0% growth) [5].
FY2022 reported (GAAP) diluted EPS was $6.73 versus $7.81 in 2021, a 13.8% decline [1]. This is a GAAP figure, not adjusted EPS.
